test_title: PYST 5: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A dozen pairs of gloves of Rs. 180 are available at a discount of 10%. How many pairs of gloves can be bought for Rs. 54?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Discounted Price** of 12 pairs = 180 − (10% of 180) = 180 − 18 = 162.

**Price per pair** = 162 ÷ 12 = 13.5.

**Number of pairs** for Rs. 54 = 54 ÷ 13.5 = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 pairs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **Marked Price (MP)** of 12 pairs = Rs. 180, **Discount** = 10%, **Total Amount** = Rs. 54.
Formulas: SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100 | Quantity = Total Amount ÷ SP per unit.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be5936b74cc1ac55468d55716b728a7ea1e2aaecb6e578a769da96059e7e8fdb.png] 
⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** for 12 pairs = 180 × (90 ÷ 100) = Rs. 162.
⇒ Cost of **1 pair** of gloves = 162 ÷ 12 = Rs. 13.5.
⇒ Pairs bought for Rs. 54 = 54 ÷ 13.5.
⇒ Pairs = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 pairs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

The **Marked Price** is the price printed on the label. **Discount** is always calculated on the MP to find the **Selling Price**.

Unitary Method

Finding the value of a single unit first (price per pair) helps in calculating the quantity for any given total amount.
